name: How long does a gas line pressure test take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a gas line pressure test take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a gas line pressure test can vary depending on the size and complexity of your gas system. A standard test for a residential property usually takes between 30 minutes to a few hours. This includes the setup, the actual testing period for pressure monitoring, and initial assessment. If a leak is found, locating and repairing it will extend the overall time needed for the service.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard residential gas line pressure test typically takes 30 minutes to a few hours, depending on system size and complexity.
